en_description: ovnfs executable; unset looks for `ovnfs` on PATH. When it is found, ovnfs checkouts (copy-on-write views of a folder, ready in about a second at any size) serve every separate copy: the system prompt tells agents to open checkouts instead of git worktrees or copies, and isolated subagents (when allowed, with `isolation.backend` on auto) run in checkouts instead of native clones
Ask the native judge resolved through the 'judge' role which parts of each new top-level prompt can run concurrently. Needs a native judge and the task tool; without them nothing is judged.

Spawns take ordered `steps` instead of one `task`: the subagent gets the first step, then each next one once it finishes the previous; past 4 steps, earlier messages carry two or more. The last step's result is the task's result.

Whether a subagent call may pick its model with one exact provider/model-id[@upstream][:level] selector. An @upstream pin is part of the model identity and is supported only by aggregators. Only models the configuration already routes to are accepted. Project settings can turn it off but not on, and never approve a model.

Exact selectors: `provider/model-id`, including `@upstream` only for a pinned OpenRouter/Vercel route (e.g. `openrouter/x@y`). When set, a per-call model must also be listed here. Empty: every model the configuration grants. A project list can only narrow this one.

Maximum worker threads for subagents. Up to 8 concurrent subagents run on the main thread; at 9 one worker joins, and one more each time the count doubles (18, 36, 72). Workers stop a minute after no subagent is live in them; 0 keeps every subagent on the main thread
Ask the judge model role whether each automatically recalled memory is relevant to the task before injecting it
Backend for analysis selectors in read and eval's dsm namespace; bare executable reads show metadata only. Auto uses IDA Pro when installed, else Ghidra (downloaded on first analysis)
Most databases (omp.ida.* / omp.ghidra.* daemons in omp ps) open at once per project; opening another evicts an unreferenced idle one. Close retained dsm handles when done
Save and close unreferenced databases idle longer than this many seconds (0 = never); retained dsm handles stay open. The exec namespace resets on reopen
Ghidra 12+ install directory (contains Ghidra/application.properties); empty uses $GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR, Homebrew, else a managed download under ~/.omp/ghidra
Python interpreter that can import pyghidra; empty uses a managed venv built from the install's bundled wheels
Let retain and learn take scope: global, which stores a memory without the project tag so every project recalls it. Needs global or per-project-tagged scoping

Exact environment variable names allowed as leading KEY=VALUE prefixes when matching bash.patterns allow rules (no wildcards). Any value is accepted, so list only benign build/test variables; execution-altering variables (PATH, LD_PRELOAD, BASH_ENV, *_RUNNER, *_WRAPPER) allow arbitrary command execution.
Turn providers we paused back on: login, token refresh and stored credentials work again. Each pause names the account risk you accept. Project settings cannot set this
How often a long turn is reminded to update its todo list while it keeps changing things

Model selector (e.g. openrouter/liquid/d1-ultra) tried first for find's passage verification, before the judge role; filename and sketch ranking stay on the judge role. Unset: the judge role verifies too
Enable the commit eval prelude and /commit: commit only the lines this agent and its subagents wrote
Let the agent reply mid-task by writing to out://, shown like a response without ending its turn. Unset: on in the interactive TUI, off in print, RPC, and ACP

en_label: Wake Print Mode on Job Results
en_description: In print mode (-p, --mode json), keep running after the last prompt while this run's background jobs are active, and start another turn in the same session with each job's result; exits once no job or result is pending. Off: print mode exits after its prompts and cancels running jobs
Show an `xd://: mounted …` notice when MCP or extension tools are mounted or unmounted. The model still learns of the change with its next prompt.

omp's WebKit engine: its host executable, or an ABKit engine directory (which holds it as ABHost; ABHost.exe on Windows). If unset, omp runs the installed engine, ~/.o2/lib/abkit/ABHost (ABHost.exe on Windows). Supports ~. PI_BROWSER_WEBKIT_PATH overrides it.
Maximum width in terminal columns for inline images (default 100). Set to 0 for unlimited (bounded only by terminal width).
Maximum height in terminal rows for inline images (default 20). Set to 0 to use only the viewport-based limit (60% of terminal height).

Maximum number of inline images kept as live terminal graphics (default 8). Older images fall back to a text placeholder via a full redraw once the limit is exceeded. Set to 0 to keep every image (no limit).
Color headings by level, bold and italic text, inline code, and table headers from the theme's ANSI palette. Off uses one heading color and plain bold/italic.
Invite the agent to show pictures with and web pages with
Milliseconds between frames of every spinner, the terminal title included; 0 shows static glyphs. Unset follows Motion
Ceiling on how often the TUI repaints, streaming text included. Keystroke echo keeps 30 fps, so the pane you type in stays responsive
One switch over spinners, shimmer, and decorative blink/fade. Streaming text is unaffected (see Max Frames Per Second). A spinner interval you set still wins
Show bash commands as an interactive execution visualization instead of plain shell commands
Maximum note lines a collapsed advisor card shows below its header (0 keeps the full preview; expand with the tool-output toggle)
When you ask /btw for a steering prompt, it drafts one in <inject> tags, highlighted in the answer; Alt+I (app.btw.inject) sends it to the main session
Install omp updates in the background on startup; the next launch runs the new version
Every this many operator prompts, ask the judge model whether a generated session title still fits the conversation, and regenerate it if not
Shape tool output and rank find results with Stencil Spotlight, and log each shaped result to the session
Choose whether the resume picker's current folder includes sessions from other repository worktrees
Model or role (default '@default') that /prewalk restart returns to for planning.
Model or role (default '@smol') that prewalk hands off to at the first edit/write: /prewalk, /prewalk restart, Enable Prewalk, and --prewalk. Auto-prewalk uses its own target.
Let extensions enter and exit plan, vibe, goal, and loop modes via ctx.sessionModes.set(); reading mode state stays available
Let extensions change how assistant replies are drawn, redraw a reply in place, and receive clicks on their own links; the session, exports and model context keep the reply as written
Let extensions draw transcript blocks such as tool calls in full, as one compact row, or hidden; the session, exports and model context are unchanged
Base URL of an OpenAI Realtime WebRTC-compatible server (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1) used for live voice instead of Codex; empty uses Codex
Bearer key sent only to the live endpoint: a literal, an environment variable name, or !command
